evidence: Five real Windows x64 tests on the committed candidate launch a locally signed, inventory-verified packaged Python worker inside a zero-capability LPAC, with a separately frozen Core/guardian. The hostile connector is denied synthetic unrelated-project and vault reads, parent environment secret, project/profile/temp/runtime/outside writes, child-process breakaway, and direct loopback before transport. No listener receives a connection. The guardian's exact-resource recovery is exercised before seal, after Core crash, and under delayed OS locks. These are local test-signing and pre-transport denial results, not release signing or an observed public-address connect; the earlier adverse probes and the R49 feasibility disposition remain in the retained LPAC gate note.

The live Core broker tests reject changed scientific input, forged or stale grants, undeclared operations, changed URL/host/method, private DNS targets, redirects, oversized or malformed responses, unsupported credentials, and failed audit before synthetic transport. Signed destination and credential scope, current project consent, per-origin secrets, rate/retry limits, content-free denial audit, and fenced result staging are checked in the 67-test service run. No real external source or secret is used.

Sixty-seven exact-candidate Core connector tests pass, including successful signed package review/trust/enable/dispatch through a synthetic broker, persisted grant and encrypted package restart, same-key re-trust and key-rotation renewal, changed scientific identifier denial before egress, exact identifier success, cancellation/revocation and late-result fences, credential scope denial, malformed frames, and v20 encrypted migration with verified backup/reopen.

Five native signed LPAC/guardian boundary tests pass. The full desktop application qualification passes nine commands and 72 real style cases, including Source Manager in light/dark themes at three viewport sizes; focused TypeScript and Rust checks are included there. Six packaging tests pass with one expected environment skip. The frozen Core sidecar package builds with 783 files and the signed-worker bundle is verified at runtime.

The T02 diff updates signed-runtime inventory and build inputs, Core-owned grants/jobs/encrypted package repositories behind ports, native review/status/cancel contracts, broker/audit/provenance documentation, Windows LPAC worker and guardian, Source Manager's approved connector-review panel, security fixtures, and exact encrypted v20 migration/restart tests. The temporary architecture port additions and their boundary rationale are recorded in artifacts/evidence/CAP-04.S05.T02.architecture-boundary-maintenance.md; no scope or security boundary reduction is claimed.

Generated Core API contract, architecture policy, 516-file Python quality and clean build manifest pass on the exact commit. The desktop qualification passes after restoring the approved flex-wrapping panel action row. The retained feasibility-gate note discloses earlier failed diagnostics and the precise public-route observation limit; the task neither claims a public packet-level denial nor authorizes a weaker AppContainer or writable scratch.
